import pytest


def parity(x: int) -> bool:
    """True when the byte (an int from 0 to 255) has an odd number of set bits."""
    if not 0 <= x <= 255:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected byte in range 0..255, got {x}")
    return x.bit_count() % 2 == 1


def test_parity_zero() -> None:
    assert parity(0) is False


def test_parity_single_bit() -> None:
    assert parity(1) is True
    assert parity(2) is True
    assert parity(4) is True
    assert parity(128) is True


def test_parity_two_bits() -> None:
    assert parity(3) is False
    assert parity(5) is False
    assert parity(129) is False


def test_parity_three_bits() -> None:
    assert parity(7) is True
    assert parity(11) is True


def test_parity_full_byte() -> None:
    assert parity(255) is False
    assert parity(254) is True


def test_parity_invalid_range() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parity(-1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parity(256)
